{{Quote|Tucker on Five, waiting for Mother Bird. Over.|Tucker checks in|audio=WaitingForMotherBird-SOR.flac|<ref name="sor" />}}
'''Tucker''' was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] who flew in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Blue [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] task force sent to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberate]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] control. During the ensuing battle, Tucker and Blue Squadron&mdash;under the command of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]&mdash;made their way toward the enemy's [[Procurer|flagship]], attempting to break the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Ryloth. However, Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] attacked Tucker and Blue Squadron, and after inflicting some casualties on the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] group, the Vultures proceeded to attack the Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] then ordered the squadron to retreat, but at Tano's behest, the starfighters continued the assault on the Confederate [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. With the Republic fighters heavily outnumbered, Tucker was shot down and [[Death/Legends|killed]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right boys, let's clear a path.|Ahsoka Tano, to Blue Squadron, during the Battle of Ryloth|<ref name="sor" />}}
Tucker was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="sor" /> Like all other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], Tucker was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] and trained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="CE" /> Tucker served in [[Blue Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "[[Blue Five/Legends|Blue Five]]."<ref name="sor" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|captured]] the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and subjugated the native [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants. A Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that included Tucker and Blue Squadron and was led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was dispatched to the [[Ryloth system/Legends|Ryloth system]] in response. The Republic forces were tasked with breaking the Confederate [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]]&mdash;under the command of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]]&mdash;surrounding the planet, in order to allow Republic ground forces to land on Ryloth.<ref name="sor" />

[[File:Blue_Squadron_Ryloth.png|thumb|left|270px|Blue Squadron during the Battle of Ryloth]]
After the Republic arrived over Ryloth, Blue Squadron, led by Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], left the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of Skywalker's [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], in their [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to destroy the enemy [[Procurer|command ship]]. As Tano led Tucker and Blue Squadron toward the Confederate blockade containing the enemy [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], they were quickly [[Starfighter combat/Legends|confronted]] by swarms of Confederate [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], sent by Tuuk to destroy the Republic fighters.<ref name="sor" />

Tucker and Blue Squadron engaged the Vulture [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and sustained damage in the ensuing fight, but the squadron continued its assault toward the Confederate flagship. However, four additional [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]] soon joined the Confederate blockade, heavily outnumbering the Republic task force. Waves of Vulture droids began attacking the Republic fleet's Venator [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], forcing Skywalker and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] to order Blue Squadron to fall back and protect the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. However, Tano disobeyed, and at her command, Blue Squadron continued its assault on the enemy [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], harassed by groups of more Vultures. Tucker was shot down en route to the Confederate flagship by a Vulture droid. He [[Death/Legends|perished]] as his starfighter exploded.<ref name="sor" />

==Personality and traits==
Tucker was an experienced fighter [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and he was also trained in military tactics. Before the Battle of Ryloth, he figured out that the chances of surviving the battle were slim, due to the numeric advantage held by the Confederates.<ref name="CE" /> Nevertheless, he carried out his orders without hesitation.<ref name="sor" /> Tucker also found [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]] to be beautiful, although other pilots of Blue Squadron considered him to be odd as a result. Despite his fondness for starfighter combat, Tucker wished that he could watch the Battle of Ryloth from a distance instead of being in the midst of the chaos. A [[human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Fett clone, he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall (6 [[Foot/Legends|ft]])<ref name="CE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Equipment==
Tucker wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] clone pilot [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and had the insignia of Blue Squadron adorned on his helmet. He possessed a [[DC-15s side arm blaster|DC-15 blaster pistol]].<ref name="CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tucker first appeared in "[[Storm Over Ryloth]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[February 27]], [[2009]]. Like all clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the series, Tucker was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="sor guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode019.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref>
